title: broker.json
description: Content of the file broker.json in the Message Bus storage /etc/oi4/mqtt of a container (RIG 4.1.1): the settings of the MQTT broker. Used by the infrastructure compliance CLI (D8); REQ-CNT-003 keeps the verification d8 (ADR-0019 amendment C-039). Further elements are allowed (SF-100 (a), proposed), so the file has no closure and no tolerant variant of its own.
$comment: REQ-CNT-003 (RIG 4.1.1): broker.json is a JSON object with the mandatory elements Address, SecurePort and MaxPacketSize

Address.$comment: REQ-CNT-003 (RIG 4.1.1): IP address or host name of the broker – an IPv4 address in dotted-decimal form, an IPv6 address in text form without brackets and zone (IPv6address of RFC 3986) or a host name of RFC 1123 whose last label is not all digits (SF-100 (b), proposed)

SecurePort.$comment: REQ-CNT-003 (RIG 4.1.1): UINT16 port on which the broker listens for TLS connections; port 0 is no such port (SF-100 (c), proposed)

MaxPacketSize.$comment: REQ-CNT-003 (RIG 4.1.1, SF-091): INT32 maximum size of an MQTT payload in bytes, at least 262144 (256 KiB) and at most 268435455 (maximum remaining length of an MQTT v3.1.1 packet)
